b_r1_verdict: The darker arrow flew through the lines clearly and I can easily tell where it came out and went to. Darker puffs provide extra hints for the result of the battle, which keep more attention focusing on the result of each turn within limited time.
price_conclusion: Both effects are under the 0.2 ms budget on the price that matters: A on CPU (0.0078 ms) and GPU (0.0031 ms), B on GPU (0.0074 ms). Both predictions were too low, but by less than 0.01 ms — B's CPU cost wasn't 0 because the trail is moved every frame. The Visual Profiler couldn't show these prices since the frame-to-frame swing (~1.5 ms) hides them; only means over many frames separate the cases, and with vsync on its RV includes display waiting, not the effects' work.
